facts.text: The hotel occupies the top 31 floors of the 72-story Zhuhai Tower.
facts.excerpt: Taking up the top 31 floors of the iconic, 72-story Zhuhai Tower

facts.text: The hotel is a waterfront hotel in Wanzai, Zhuhai.
facts.excerpt: our luxury hotel is a waterfront haven in Wanzai

facts.text: The closest airport is Macau International Airport, about 14 km from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The closest airport near The St. Regis Zhuhai is Macau International Airport (MFM). MFM is located approximately 14.0 KM from the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle service.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

facts.text: Yan Ting, on the 42nd floor, serves classic Cantonese a la carte fine dining with city views of Macao and Zhuhai.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 42nd floor overseeing the stunning city views of Macao and Zhuhai, Yan Ting offers classic Cantonese, à la carte fine dining

facts.text: LaBrezza, on the 71st floor, is an Italian fine-dining restaurant serving Southern Italian cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Located on 71st floor, the Italian fine-dining restaurant LaBrezza offers Southern Italian cuisine.

facts.text: LaBrezza has an open kitchen, a cheese and cold cuts room and a wine cellar with over 400 labels.

facts.text: Social, the buffet restaurant on the 41st floor, draws inspiration from the first-class dining saloons of early 1900s cruise vessels.

facts.text: The St. Regis Bar on the 41st floor offers Signature Afternoon Tea and the Pearly Mary.

facts.text: Iridium Spa is on the 68th floor and offers a menu of locally inspired therapies.
